The '''Gardens of T'alla''' were gardens that, according to the [[Qel-Droma Epics]], existed on the [[Jedi]] [[planet]] [[Ossus]]. According to the Epics, the gardens were built at the [[Great Jedi Library]] by the [[Neti]] [[Jedi Master]] [[T'alla]], who later planted herself at the center, becoming a [[tree]]. The Epics further claimed that the gardens continued to grow over [[Millennium|millennia]], and that the tree thought to be T'alla was a favored spot for visitors to meditate. The Jedi [[Agricultural Corps]] built greenhouses in the Gardens where they grew and experimented with plants. Constructing vast hedge mazes and exotic flower beds, the rock garden would eventually inspire the [[Muntuur Stones of Coruscant|Muntuur Stones]] of [[Coruscant]].<ref name="NOP" />
